showcase.title: Cleaning Services for Every Space
showcase.subtitle: Keeping Every Space Cleaner With Our Detail-Clean Rotation System
showcase.body: At SM Nettoyage, we follow a structured rotation system to deep clean every service we offer; homes, offices, windows, after-construction cleaning, and move-in/move-out cleaning. This ensures consistent, thorough sanitation across every space, tailored to your specific needs. With SM Nettoyage, cleanliness isn't occasional, it's guaranteed.

process.subtitle: A simple, clear path — from your request to our visit.

1.title: Request
1.body: Tell us about your space and needs through our quote or booking form.

2.title: Confirmation
2.body: We follow up quickly to confirm the time slot and the details.

3.title: Visit
3.body: Our team arrives on time, fully equipped, and leaves a careful, reliable result.

home.title: Home Cleaning
home.short: Thorough cleaning for apartments and houses — kitchens, bathrooms, living areas, and more.
home.long: Regular or one-off home cleaning that covers dusting, floors, kitchens, bathrooms, and high-touch surfaces. We adapt to your preferences so your home feels fresh every visit.

office.title: Office Cleaning
office.short: Professional workplace cleaning that keeps your team productive and your spaces welcoming.
office.long: Scheduled office cleaning for desks, meeting rooms, kitchens, and common areas. Discreet, reliable service outside or during your working hours.

windows.title: Window Cleaning
windows.short: Streak-free windows that let the light in and make your property shine.
windows.long: Interior and exterior window cleaning for homes and commercial spaces. Clear glass, clean frames, and a brighter look for every room.

construction.title: After-Construction Cleaning
construction.short: Post-renovation cleanup that removes dust, debris, and residue so the space is move-in ready.
construction.long: Detailed cleaning after building or renovation work — fine dust, adhesive residue, floors, and fixtures — so you can enjoy the finished space without the mess.

moving.title: After-Moving & Pre-Moving Cleaning
moving.short: House cleaning before you move in or after you move out — for a clean start at every address.
moving.long: Deep cleaning for houses before handover or after arrival. Empty-home cleans, cupboards, floors, and bathrooms so keys are exchanged with confidence.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A cleaning partner you can trust — cleanliness, reliability, and care in every visit.
about.storyBody: At SM Nettoyage, our experienced and professional team delivers high-standard cleaning services for homes, offices, and commercial spaces. Our team includes specialists holding the CFC certificate, and all our work is carried out with modern equipment and professional cleaning methods. Through our reliable, meticulous, and client-focused approach, we transform your living and working spaces into hygienic, healthy, and fresh environments. While you focus on your daily life, you can safely leave the cleaning to us.
about.value1Body: Clear communication, punctual arrivals, and consistent quality you can plan around.
about.value2Body: Respect for your home, workplace, and belongings — every surface, every time.
about.value3Body: From one-off deep cleans to recurring schedules, we adapt to your life and business.
about.ctaBody: Tell us what you need — we will prepare a free quote.

booking.subtitle: Tell us about your space and preferred time. We will follow up to confirm.
booking.asideBody: After you send a request, we confirm the time slot by email or phone. Our team follows a Detail-Clean approach for a careful, reliable result.
